analysis.primary_metric: geometric exact expected leading-risk ratio to strong fixed q after all probe messages
analysis.active_cell: cellwise asymptotic oracle q differs from overhead-specific strong fixed q

mandatory_gates.B1: public kernel, stationarity, and marginal-invariance checks pass
mandatory_gates.B2: every minimal fingerprint has exact independent-path collision <= 0.01
mandatory_gates.B3: every delayed recursion is stable and the post-probe q=16 learning horizon meets the 1e-4 contraction rule
mandatory_gates.B4: aggregate geometric exact expected full-cost improvement >= 0.05
mandatory_gates.B5: geometric exact expected full-cost improvement >= 0.05 for each message overhead
mandatory_gates.B6: exact expected ratio < 1 in at least 0.70 of oracle-active cells
mandatory_gates.B7: maximum exact expected ratio over every cell <= 1.05
mandatory_gates.B8: exact action distributions are normalized and plug-in participation is nonincreasing in the sufficient statistic
mandatory_gates.B9: probe messages, probe environment transitions, learning messages, learning transitions, and delay satisfy separate budgets
mandatory_gates.B10: no sampled trajectory, seed, GPU, HPC4 job, T-049A row, or T-051A row is used
